name: 90025 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90025 (Los Angeles) has 381 nonprofit organizations. 123 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 96 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90025 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
